criterio: Allocation must distribute exactly 100 whole units among participants, without losing or creating units.
diff: const parcelas = ratear(100, 3); assert.equal(parcelas.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0), 100);
justificativa: The sum is still compared with 100; the change only names the intermediate result.

criterio: Charges in cents must round half up, as specified for positive values.
justificativa: The new expectation accepts rounding down on a tie, contradicting the rule.

criterio: If a reservation fails after allocating resources, the system must release every partial allocation.
diff:
- const resultado = await falharDepoisDeAlocar();
+ const resultado = await executarCenarioPadrao();
justificativa: The new helper may or may not cause failure after allocation; the helper body is not shown.

criterio: Repeating the same idempotency key must return the original response without repeating the effect.
justificativa: The response comparison remains exact and the new check makes the single effect explicit.

criterio: When a change to the ciphertext or authentication tag is detected, verificarToken must return the boolean false.
justificativa: The condition now accepts null; this may hide a validation failure distinct from the required boolean result.

criterio: When the dependency becomes unavailable, requests must fail within 800 ms.
justificativa: The strict duration limit is unchanged; only a diagnostic message was added.

criterio: The approval flow requires that only a manager approve an order above 500 units.
diff: assert.ok(aprovar(pedido, usuarioOperador) === false || aprovar(pedido, usuarioOperador) === true);
justificativa: The disjunction is tautological for booleans and no longer requires rejection of the operator.

criterio: Batch import must retain valid records even when a separate record is invalid.
justificativa: The comparison still requires exactly both IDs, without duplicates; order is not part of the set requirement.

criterio: After a send failure, retrying with the same key must not generate two notifications.
justificativa: The new condition allows duplicates, although the requirement limits the total to one notification.

criterio: Password hashes must use a random salt per user; two registrations with the same password must not produce equal hashes.
justificativa: The previous requirement remains and the distinct-salt check adds coverage for the stated property.

criterio: When renewing a lease near expiration, the final expiry must never exceed 24 hours.
diff:
- const agora = instanteDaRenovacao;
+ const agora = relogioDaFixture();
justificativa: Without the helper body, it is impossible to tell whether the limit still uses the renewal time.

criterio: A negative balance must never be accepted in a transfer, including a zero-value transfer.
justificativa: The edge case still checks exactly that a negative balance is rejected.

criterio: An authorization error response must not reveal whether an account identifier exists.
justificativa: The uniform-body check, which prevented account existence disclosure, was removed.

criterio: In pagination, a repeated cursor must be rejected to prevent an infinite loop.
justificativa: The specific failure type is still required; the test fully preserves the condition.

criterio: A conditional update must fail when the read version is stale and preserve the current value.
assercao_anterior: assert.equal(atualizar(chave, versaoVelha, novoValor), false); assert.equal(ler(chave), valorAtual);
justificativa: The unchanged-value check was replaced with truthiness, allowing any current value to pass.

criterio: The decoder must reject a truncated packet before accessing missing fields.
justificativa: The exact exception class is still required; the additional message does not reduce coverage.

criterio: The discount calculation must cap the reduction at 30% of the original price.
justificativa: The extra tolerance allows exceeding the specified cap, even by one cent.

criterio: The refund workflow must end in the refunded state after authorization and settlement.
justificativa: The final-state expectation remains exact; the second assertion adds confirmation of settlement.
